How the Scrabble word finder works

  1. Type the tiles on your rack, from 2 to 7. For a blank tile, type ? or _. You can use up to two, the same as a Scrabble set.
  2. Tap Find words, or press Enter.
  3. Every word your rack can make is listed with its score, highest first, then A to Z when scores tie.

A blank stands for whatever letter the word needs and scores 0, so the page tells you what it's standing for. With C?T you'll see CAT (blank = A), COT (blank = O) and CUT (blank = U), each worth 4 points: 3 for the C, 1 for the T, nothing for the blank. Use the length, first-letter and last-letter filters when you need a word to fit a gap on the board.

How the score is calculated

Each word's score is the sum of the standard English Scrabble tile values in the table above, with blanks worth 0. QUIZ is Q 10 + U 1 + I 1 + Z 10 = 22 points. CAT and ACT are 5 each, and AT is 2.

Scores are for the word alone. The board isn't part of this tool, so double and triple letter squares, double and triple word squares, the 50-point bonus for using all seven tiles, and points from words you cross aren't added. Words With Friends gives some letters different values, so its scores won't match these.

Which words it knows

About 60,000 common English words from SCOWL, a free English word list by Kevin Atkinson, with names, abbreviations, slurs and swear words left out. It isn't the official Scrabble dictionary, so a few Scrabble-only words like QI, ZA and XU won't show up, and once in a while a word it lists might be challenged in a tournament. For a club or tournament game, check the play against the dictionary your game uses.

Ways to use it

  • Finding your best play. See the highest-scoring words on your rack at a glance.
  • Learning the letter values. Watch how one J, X, Q or Z changes the top of the list.
  • Words With Friends. The words work the same way, though the scores differ.
  • Practice after a game. Put in a rack you were stuck on and see what you missed.

Everything runs in your browser

The word list is built into the page and the search runs on your device. Nothing you type is sent to a server or saved.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do blank tiles work?

Type a blank as ? or _, up to two of them. A blank can be any letter and scores 0. Each word shows which letter the blank is standing for, like CATS (blank = S).

How is the score calculated?

By adding up the standard Scrabble tile values: 1 for A, E, I, O, U, L, N, S, T and R, 2 for D and G, 3 for B, C, M and P, 4 for F, H, V, W and Y, 5 for K, 8 for J and X, and 10 for Q and Z. Blanks are 0.

Does it include board bonuses?

No. It scores the word by itself. Double and triple letter or word squares, the 50-point bingo bonus and crossing words depend on where you play, and the board isn't part of this tool.

How many letters can I enter?

From 2 to 7 tiles, the size of a Scrabble rack, with up to 2 of them blanks.

Is my input uploaded anywhere?

No. The word list is built into the page and the search runs in your browser, so nothing you type is sent or saved.
